caption: The drawing depicts a single small table with a wooden appearance. The tabletop is brown with an irregular, scalloped edge, and has a slight sheen suggesting a polished finish. The table rests on a single, turned central pedestal that tapers and then flares out. At the base, there are three curved legs extending outward from the center, all in the same brown wooden color as the tabletop. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige in color, with no other objects or details present. The table is centered in the composition, and there are no additional decorative elements in the scene.
